label: A determinations and B relations in…: Past, present and future are the A determinations McTaggart…
term: A determinations and B relations in McTaggart’s time argument
definition: Past, present and future are the A determinations McTaggart says an event successively bears. Earlier and later are B relations he treats as permanent between events. A reference-time argument in an analyst’s semantics, an objectively privileged present and a second temporal reality are distinct possible commitments. The definition does not decide which is required for actual time.
